one_liner: Ranks every number by how many times it was drawn in all earlier draws of the current era.
registry_status_reason: Accepted implementation (Package 2 v0.11-r1, NAMES-1, E1-ALIGN); stage-1 contract declaration installed with E2R-CODE-1.
short_explanation: E_1 counts how often each number appeared in every draw before the target draw, within the current era of the game, and ranks the numbers from most to least often drawn. Numbers with equal counts are put in a fixed order by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not the order they came out in or the dates. It is a baseline: if the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
